title: Moisture Monitoring Visits on Water Damage Mitigation Jobs
content:
Water Damage Mitigation moisture monitoring is billed by the visit day while the job is drying.

The job must be in drying status when a monitoring visit is charged. Each day a technician takes and logs moisture readings on site is a monitoring visit day billed at the monitoring visit fee of the job's tier. At most one monitoring visit is charged per job per calendar day. On tiers where the set-day monitoring fee is waived, a visit on the drying start date is not charged because the set-day readings are covered by moisture mapping. A monitoring visit day is also what supports billing an equipment day beyond the billable drying day cap.

## Points of judgement
| Situation (hypothetical) | Charge |
|---|---|
| Readings taken and logged on site on a drying day after the set day | one visit at the tier's monitoring visit fee |
| A second visit on the same calendar day | not charged; one visit per job per calendar day |
| Readings on the drying start date on a tier where the set-day fee is waived | not charged |
| A visit while the job is in drying complete status | not charged; the job must be in drying status |

The amount of a monitoring visit line is the tier's monitoring visit fee itself. The check of one visit per day rests on the job's recorded charge lines for that job and calendar day.
